subject: Pricing & migration assurance for NovaTech pilot
messages:
From: Elliot Ramos <elliot.ramos@novatech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@novatech.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing review for upcoming NovaTech evaluation

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profiles and the KV cache approach. We're lining up a short pilot (6 weeks) to validate inference costs and runtime compatibility. Before we kick off, procurement asked whether Redwood can provide:

- A written commitment to match our current incumbent run-rate for the pilot period (we're currently on a blended effective rate of $0.018/token with volume tiers)
- A migration assurance (credits if SLA targets missed during first 30 days)
- A simple packaging option that bundles runtime + observability for pilot customers

I've attached our RFP and a recent invoice summary so you can see the real numbers. Procurement is particularly sensitive to first-quarter economics — if you can show a path to parity (or close) for the pilot, we can accelerate approval.

Can you share a commercial outline we can take to the buyer this week?

Best,
Elliot Ramos
Head of Platform Engineering
NovaTech
attachments: NovaTech_RFP_20270401.pdf, novatech-current-invoice-summary.csv

Subject: Re: Pricing review for upcoming NovaTech evaluation

Elliot — appreciate the RFP and invoice snapshot.

Quick read-through: we can certainly design a pilot commercial structure that gets materially close to your effective run-rate while protecting both sides on SLA/availability risk. To make the proposal concrete we'll need:

1) Clarify expected token mix (prompt vs. completion) and 95th/99th latency SLO targets for the pilot (your team mentioned 150ms 95th during demo).
2) Confirmation of whether NovaTech wants logs/trace retention in the bundle (those increase our observability costs).
3) Any legal carveouts procurement requires for data residency or auditability during the pilot.

Internally looping in Sean (commercial) and Lauren (onboarding/CS) to draft an executable outline. We'll aim to get a formal proposal and a short migration runbook by Monday morning.

Proposed high-level levers we can use now so procurement has something to react to:
- Pilot credits: up to 3 months of token credits (capped) to offset migration friction
- Temporary rate match: match incumbent run-rate for pilot term with a defined post-pilot reset
- SLA assurance: service credit ladder tied to 30-day availability target (capped)

I'll follow up with the commercial draft from Sean.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales — West
Redwood Inference

Folks — putting a concrete commercial skeleton below based on the invoice you shared and our pilot playbook. I copied the baseline numbers into the attached draft proposal (redwood_proposal_novatech_v1.pdf).

Key commercial points (draft):
- Pilot term: 6 weeks (start date to be confirmed)
- Token pricing during pilot: match incumbent effective rate within 5% (we propose $0.0189/token) up to a pilot cap of 50M tokens
- Pilot credits: $45k in token credits applied against overage in pilot month 1 (declines thereafter)
- Observability bundle: included (30-day retention) for pilot; post-pilot retention priced separately
- SLA protection: if 95th latency > 250ms for more than 72 cumulative hours in first 30 days, NovaTech receives a one-time credit equal to 10% of pilot monthly spend (capped at $20k)
- Migration assistance: up to 40 engineering hours from Redwood onboarding (sprint support) — included

Commercial caveats to surface to procurement:
- We can match short-term economics for the pilot but post-pilot list rates will reset; long-term concession requires a committed volume tier or a 12m reserved capacity contract.
- Credits tied to verifiable telemetry traces that both parties agree on (we can share a data schema).

Action items:
- Marissa: confirm if the quoted pilot cap and credit amount are acceptable to present to procurement.
- Lauren: start drafting a short migration plan (low-level checkpoints + rollback path) and populate migration_plan_draft.xlsx.
- Legal: will need a short side-letter for the pilot describing credit mechanics (I can draft).

If this looks okay I can convert to a two-page commercial term sheet and send it to Elliot/Alyssa tomorrow.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Director, Commercials
Redwood Inference

Elliot / Alyssa — thanks for the patience. Attached is a concise term sheet + migration runbook summary for the pilot. Highlights:

1) Economics
- Pilot duration: 6 weeks (target start: 2027-04-20)
- Effective pilot token rate: $0.0189/token (matches incumbent within ~5% as discussed) up to 50M tokens
- Pilot credits: $45,000 one-time credit applied in month 1 against token bill

2) Packaging
- Included bundle for pilot: runtime + observability (30-day log retention) + onboarding sprint (up to 40 hours)
- Post-pilot: observability retention and long-term backup policies will incur separate fees; we'll provide modular pricing in the final commercial schedule.

3) Migration & SLA assurance
- Migration runbook: checklist attached (migration_plan_draft.xlsx) — includes rollback points and validation tests
- SLA credit: if cumulative incidents cause 95th latency > 250ms for >72 cumulative hours in first 30 days, NovaTech receives credit equal to 10% of the monthly pilot spend (capped at $20k). Credit payable as account credit against next invoice.

4) Next steps & timeline
- If you confirm verbally, we'll send a two-page side-letter and a DocuSign link for signatures (link below).
- Once signed, onboarding team (Lauren) will schedule a kick-off and share the runbook with your infra leads.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/abc123
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.company/s/record/HS-44912

Elliot — open to adjusting the pilot cap or the credit cap if procurement has a hard constraint. If you want a deeper discount in exchange for a 12-month reserved commit, we can run the numbers (we'd need expected annual token volume).

Best,
